meta.about: A `find` that names a node, with new text. The address is unambiguous and the text is the whole of what goes there, so the call rewrites that node instead of refusing.
meta.recorded-outcome: on the Web AI demos slide, asked "Edit the first bullet. Put \"hi\"", Gemma (LiteRT, native tools) emitted edit_text({"find": "bullet 1", "slide": 18, "text": "hi"}) — the same shape it had sent a turn earlier for "make the bullet points 1. Pikachu, ...". The address-as-`find` refusal said to pass it as `target`; on the native path the model read that as a tool response and answered "I was unable to edit the text of the first bullet point" both times, never making the second call. Replayed without `slide`, which a bare `{at}` cannot express inside a reply and which changes nothing here: the replay is already on that slide.
meta.guards: the `rewrite` branch in edit_text's address-as-`find` path. Without it this call is refused, the slide is unchanged, and the turn reports `no line matching "bullet 1: hi"`.
